title: Council progress check
description: Output of the facilitator's check after the critiques and after each revision round: whether another revision round could still change a position. Not a contribution.

positions_moving.description: true when a member's position is likely to change in another round: a critique is still unanswered, new evidence was raised, or a member changed position in the last round. false when positions have settled, agreed or not.

reason.description: What you based the judgement on, naming members.

open_disagreements.description: Disagreements still standing, each naming the members on each side.
